content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe offers a comprehensive payment processing solution that integrates with a wide range of platforms, from ecommerce websites to mobile applications. Gumroad, on the other hand, provides a more specialized platform for selling digital products, but its payment processing capabilities are limited. Meanwhile, Lemon Squeezy offers a more robust set of features, including automatic tax calculations and subscription management, but its payment processing fees are higher than those of Stripe. These differences in scope and feature set make each platform more suitable for certain types of creators and businesses.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving a significant portion of the global creator community without access to its payment network. PayPal, while available in many countries, has been known to restrict access in certain regions, and a suspension can have severe consequences for creators relying on the platform. In contrast, CoreMerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution that enables creators to sell software and digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal, providing a reliable and secure alternative for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe's payment processing speed is generally faster than that of Gumroad, with funds typically available within 24-48 hours. However, Gumroad's fees are lower for smaller transactions, making it a more cost-effective option for creators selling low-priced digital products. Lemon Squeezy's fees are higher due to its more comprehensive set of features, but its automatic tax calculations and subscription management capabilities make it a better choice for creators with complex business needs. CoreMerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a flat 0.5% fee for all transactions, making it a more predictable and cost-effective option for creators selling digital products.

Stripe's absence in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines leaves digital creators with no choice but to seek alternative infrastructure solutions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe's payment processing solution is highly automated, but creators still need to manage their own digital product delivery and customer support. Gumroad's platform provides more built-in automation, including automatic delivery and customer support tools, but its payment processing capabilities are limited. Lemon Squeezy offers a more comprehensive set of automation features, including automatic tax calculations and subscription management, but its payment processing fees are higher. CoreMerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution that enables creators to manage their own digital product delivery and customer support, while also providing automatic payment processing and tax calculations, making it a more comprehensive and secure option for creators selling digital products.

Creators selling low-priced digital products may find Gumroad's lower fees and built-in automation more suitable, while those with complex business needs may prefer Lemon Squeezy's more comprehensive set of features.
